verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms New Relic serves an llms.txt at docs.newrelic.com that offers clean markdown versions of the documentation. Many doc pages are also reachable at .md URLs, which gives an agent markdown-friendly docs to point at. missing for 10: the full contents and coverage of llms.txt (the probe output is truncated), first-party documentation describing agent-oriented doc usage, and independent hands-on reports of agents consuming it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.newrelic.com/llms.txt # New Relic Documentation
